dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: Yes. Perhaps this is how fate is telling me "You're on the right path."

dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: But as a former scientist, I have to say this is all too abstract.

dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: In other words, the right path in an orderly society should be one where people with proper capabilities gain recognition.
